name: SABSA Chartered Practitioner

logistics.format: Open-book scenario-based written exams across multiple advanced SABSA modules (e.g., A1 Risk & Governance, A3 Architecture & Design); via APMG International

formal: Accredited SABSA Advanced training in chosen modules

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Advanced written scenarios across risk, governance and design after Foundation support professional architecture responsibility at three years; mandatory training and limited regional recognition constrain portability.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Written scenario application across advanced risk and architecture modules supports professional security-design responsibility. Foundation and training prerequisites add progression, while high cost and no live technical implementation limit the operational signal.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded advanced-module written scenarios require applied risk and architecture reasoning beyond Foundation. A three-year profile supports professional design judgment, while no master-level portfolio or defense is recorded.
